purpose: Fail-closed household lot FOOTPRINT / BOUNDARY admission. Agents must know where the house ends before any Live world click. Street, asphalt, neighbor lots, canal, and Buy catalog thrash are OUTSIDE — never treat them as house contents.

LOT_BOUNDARY_OUTSIDE_FOOTPRINT.when: client_xy outside footprint_aabb OR zone in outside_zones OR lot_focus OFF_LOT

LOT_BOUNDARY_AMBIGUOUS.when: insufficient cues and no measured AABB

algorithm: 1. Observe PrintWindow: classify dominant zones + optional footprint_aabb bound to camera_revision
2. Run assess_lot_focus; OFF_LOT / AMBIGUOUS → deny world clicks
3. If Buy/Build open without build_census_lease → deny Live world clicks; Esc+F1
4. admit_world_click_in_footprint only when ON_LOT and (xy in AABB or click_zone in INTERIOR|YARD)
5. Cardinal semantics apply only after admit — never to justify street clicks
6. On deny: SAFE_CURSOR_REST then Shift+Enter lot arm; never thrash asphalt

footprint_model.note: AABB is inclusive client pixels of household lot interior+yard. Stale revision → treat as unknown (deny).

proof_non_equivalence: lot_focus ON_LOT is necessary but not sufficient without xy/zone inside footprint when AABB known
cardinal SAME_SIDE_AS does not admit a street pixel
unit PASS is not live footprint measure
